title: A E S T H E T I C
physical_identity: Vaporwave-styled giant desert of yellow and violet sand with purple marble ruins, a walkable intangible web-like sea on one side and a neon night city on the other, under a striped orange sun and gridded sky.
scale_topology: Desert ~10,000,000 km2 enclosed by mountains; ocean at north warm edge, city at south cold edge; sea 500 m deep with Digital Trenches.
anomalies: nearly intangible water that can be breathed
Tune-Out turning wanderers into Static Ghosts
lighting_sound: Sun stuck at sunset over sea with sky grid; constant night in the city; unknown-source lounge/smooth-jazz music that differs per wanderer.
